facts.fact: A referral code is not required to start Valhalla.
facts.answer_guidance: Tell the user to run /valhalla start or use the Valhalla website.

facts.fact: Users can start with /valhalla start, then use /valhalla settings_dlmm to configure copy trading.
facts.answer_guidance: Keep setup instructions short; ask whether they are using Discord or the website if the path is unclear.

facts.fact: When a user asks how much Valhalla charges, link the official Valhalla fees FAQ.
facts.answer_guidance: Use https://valhalla-bot.gitbook.io/valhalla-bot/valhalla-faq. Do not mix in old buy/sell fee wording from older pages.

facts.fact: A Decoder NFT or subscription is not required to start or use Valhalla. They provide fee discounts and unlock full access to premium Discord channels; without them, base functionality remains available.
facts.answer_guidance: Answer directly when asked about NFT or subscription requirements. Do not say either is mandatory to start. Do not state a subscription price unless it is separately verified.

facts.fact: Valhalla does not require an API key to set up or use its documented Discord flows.
facts.answer_guidance: Tell users to use /valhalla start and the documented setup commands. Never ask them to paste an API key or direct them to an obsolete third-party key provider.

facts.fact: Valhalla charges a 0.015% opening fee and a 3% claim fee on Meteora fees earned.
facts.answer_guidance: Prefer linking the fees FAQ instead of explaining the rates unless the user asks for the specific breakdown.

facts.fact: Valhalla copies supported Meteora DLMM activity from followed wallets; a normal token buy is not a DLMM position.
facts.answer_guidance: If a specific trade did not copy, escalate rather than guessing about the user's position.

facts.fact: Valhalla's documented hard cap is 50 open positions, while users can also configure a per-wallet position count and timeframe.
facts.answer_guidance: Do not promise that a user's configured limit is the only limit; specific skipped positions require investigation.

facts.fact: Valhalla results vary with the wallets followed, the user's ratio and filters, liquidity, and market conditions; staff must not promise profit.
facts.answer_guidance: Point users to the Valhalla wallets channel and /valhalla top_trade_wallets for current examples, while stating that past performance is not a guarantee.

facts.fact: DAMM v2 copying is in beta and can have bugs; users testing it should use an amount they are comfortable risking and specific issues should be escalated.
facts.answer_guidance: Do not describe DAMM as fully stable or guarantee that a test will work.

facts.fact: A missed or differing Valhalla copy can involve skipped positions, timing, filters, liquidity, or execution state; the bot cannot identify the cause from a message alone.
facts.answer_guidance: Ask for the safe webhook or position context and route a specific discrepancy to a human; never invent a cause.

facts.fact: Valhalla can be started from the website at https://valhalla-bot.app/ as an alternative to the Discord command flow.
facts.answer_guidance: Point users to the official site or /valhalla start; do not ask for wallet keys or credentials.

facts.fact: The copy ratio is intended to make the follower risk a similar proportion of their wallet as the followed trader risks of theirs.
facts.answer_guidance: Explain the proportion first. Do not promise profit or recommend a personal risk level.

facts.fact: Entry Mode supports SOL_ONLY, SOL_OR_USDC, and ANY, with safety rails able to clamp the effective mode to SOL_ONLY.
facts.answer_guidance: Explain tradeoffs without telling the user which mode will make money. A specific unexpected skip is an escalation.

facts.fact: When the Jupiter score is 30 or lower, Pumpfun and StonkFun-only behavior is automatically enforced as a safety measure, subject to configured exemptions.
facts.answer_guidance: Do not describe the safety rail as a guarantee or advise bypassing it.

facts.fact: Questions about private keys, PIN recovery, missing funds, withdrawals, or suspected wallet compromise must go to a human.
facts.answer_guidance: Never request or repeat a seed phrase, private key, or access token.

facts.fact: Specific Valhalla positions, balances, PnL, failed or duplicated copies, withdrawals, and unexpected funds require human investigation.
facts.answer_guidance: Ask for safe context such as the wallet display name, pool, or screenshot; never ask for private keys or seed phrases.

facts.fact: Olympus is a web terminal for Polymarket manual trading, copy trading, markets, sports, perps, leverage, combos, and related workflows.
facts.answer_guidance: Use the official docs for feature-specific instructions.

facts.fact: Users sign in to Olympus on the website with Discord or Gmail through Privy, then fund the trading wallet and optionally follow a wallet.
facts.answer_guidance: Link the official getting-started guide for a full walkthrough.

facts.fact: Imported wallet flows are available in Olympus.
facts.answer_guidance: Do not assume an imported wallet has the same Safe or gasless setup as an Olympus-created wallet; inspect the account-specific wallet type and escalate when needed.

facts.fact: Olympus-created Deposit Wallets are gasless for supported trading flows, while legacy Safe or EOA setups can have different gas requirements; imported wallets must be checked by wallet type.
facts.answer_guidance: Explain the distinction without promising that a particular user's wallet is gasless; ask which wallet type or request safe account context when necessary.

source.ref: older Olympus wallet support replies and inspected screenshots 2026-09-08

facts.fact: An Olympus account can show separate signing and trading addresses; the signing address signs transactions and the trading address holds trading funds and positions.
facts.answer_guidance: Explain the roles briefly. If the displayed addresses or funds do not match the expected account, route it to a human.

facts.fact: Olympus detects a followed leader's activity and attempts to mirror it using the follower's ratio, size limits, filters, and execution mode.
facts.answer_guidance: A specific missing, duplicated, incorrectly sized, or unexpectedly filled trade must be escalated.

facts.fact: Backtesting is a simulation of a trader's history against the user's settings, not a guarantee of future copied results.
facts.answer_guidance: Mention modeled fills and the user's own settings when relevant; never promise profitability.

facts.fact: Olympus provides a leaderboard, top-wallet views, and per-trader pages where users can inspect potential leaders before following them.
facts.answer_guidance: Point users to the Olympus leaderboard or top-wallet views. Do not present any leader as guaranteed profitable; performance depends on the leader and the user's settings.

facts.fact: In Olympus order status, Copied indicates a fill, Limit Placed indicates an order waiting for fill, and Partial Fill indicates that only part of the order filled.
facts.answer_guidance: Explain status labels without claiming a specific user's order filled; account-specific discrepancies require human review.

facts.fact: Unexpected leftover shares, slippage, skipped sells, failed copies, or mismatches between a leader and follower require investigation with the relevant webhook, order, or account context.
facts.answer_guidance: Ask for safe screenshots, order IDs, market links, or webhook details; do not promise a root cause or outcome.

source.ref: older Olympus ticket and holder-chat replies 2026-09-08

facts.fact: Olympus fee questions should be answered from the official FAQ and the dedicated feature fee schedule when applicable.
facts.answer_guidance: Do not infer a fee from a screenshot or from a different product's fee schedule.

facts.fact: Olympus does not guarantee profitability; results depend on the followed wallet, settings, fills, fees, liquidity, and market conditions.
facts.answer_guidance: Explain the risk plainly and point to backtesting or wallet activity without presenting simulated or historical results as a promise.

facts.fact: Sports markets are accessed from the Sports area; users can search or open Game View and use the market dropdown to select a market such as Moneyline.
facts.answer_guidance: If markets or outcomes are missing for a specific event, collect the event details and escalate to the product team.

facts.fact: Dimes is an external integration that powers Olympus leverage-related behavior; specific leverage, closing, or payout discrepancies require human investigation.
facts.answer_guidance: Do not claim Olympus controls Dimes' closing logic or guarantee a user's funds or outcome.

facts.fact: Specific balances, positions, PnL, redemptions, withdrawals, missing funds, and trade discrepancies must be handled by a human with account context.
facts.answer_guidance: Ask only for safe, non-secret identifiers or screenshots; never ask for private keys or seed phrases.
